description: One row per listing scored, rejects included. The four score components stay separate so a downstream factory can re-rank under its own weights. archetype_id and credential_path_id point back at the intermediates that produced the row.

employer.note: Invented. Carries the marker (fictional) inside the string so it survives into the CSV.

german_level_mapped.note: This demo's guess at what the phrasing means. The German terms have no CEFR definition.

visa_sponsorship_stated.note: Whether the advert states it, not whether it is true.

archetype_id.note: Empty where the listing falls outside the three derived archetypes.

credential_path_id.note: Key into credential-map.json. Never a verdict on equivalence.

shortlisted.note: True for the rows above the line, false for the rest. Both ship.

reason.note: One line, for shortlisted rows and rejects alike.

weights_used_on_screen.note: Published so a downstream factory can reproduce or discard the blend.
